statement: Retatrutide is a chain of 39 amino acids (the building blocks of proteins), arranged in a pattern based on the gut hormone GIP. Three of the 39 are lab-modified amino acids that the body does not normally use to build proteins. A 20-carbon fatty-acid 'tail' is chemically attached to one building block, a lysine at position 17.
